messages.content: Find out the rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies

function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores. Default ''

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
The user wants info about rewards for playing Fortnite on PlayStation platform with different missions and trophies.

We have two relevant tool calls:

1) `game_rewards_get` - get reward details given game, platform, optional mission or trophy.

2) Possibly list missions via `game_missions_list`.

User says "with different missions and trophies" – likely they want multiple queries? We could first call `game_missions_list` to get available missions, then query each mission's rewards using `game_rewards_get`. Also maybe ask for trophy levels (like Bronze, Silver, Gold). But we don't need to provide too many; just show example.

But as per policy, we should not reveal internal logic but only output results from API calls. So we will make one call to `game_rewards_get` specifying game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation". For mission and trophy unspecified? They said "different missions and trophies." Maybe we can request general rewards across all missions/trophies. Or we might do separate calls for specific ones like "Battle Pass" etc.

Better approach: First fetch list of missions, pick some sample missions, then fetch rewards for those missions and also for trophy categories.

Thus we may produce three calls: list missions, get rewards for mission X, get rewards for trophy Y.

Let's proceed stepwise.

First call: `game_missions_list({"game":"Fortnite"})`

Then choose say "Seasonal Battle Pass" and "Daily Challenges".

Second call: `game_rewards_get({"game":"Fortnite","platform":"Playstation","mission":"Seasonal Battle Pass"})`

Third call: `game_rewards_get({"game":"Fortnite","platform":"Playstation","trophy":"Gold"})`

We'll return responses accordingly.
